summary: Earth Trend Detective is an interactive web application that makes climate change accessible and personally relevant, inviting users to explore how environmental conditions have evolved across regions of their choice. Whether motivated by curiosity, relocation, or concern for their local environment, users can investigate questions such as “Are the hottest days getting hotter?” or “Is this region becoming drier?”. Using Earth observation data retrieved through NASA’s Giovanni platform, the application analyzes historical trends in average temperature, maximum temperature, and precipitation. Built with Streamlit, it combines intuitive data cards, trend visualizations, and statistical evidence to make complex findings easy to interpret. A guided tutorial connects these insights to everyday life, encouraging users to explore, question, and better understand the changing world around them.
details: It shows global earth trends through an interactive map where people can learn from intuitive insights how the world is changing and how may it impact our lives. It makes all these insights accessible and interactive, so that a non-expert audience can still learn about the world's situation. We considered that the tool should be easy to use, interactive and insightful. The main focus of it is to inform the audience, supported by trusted data from NASA, about the world's situation related to climate change.
